findings.title: Generate the queued timestamp for each AssignmentSource instance
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` created without an explicit `queued` value receives the same timestamp, potentially from days earlier in a long-running worker. Both `from_integration()` and `from_dict()` when the timestamp is omitted use this default, so the serialized metadata does not record when the assignment was queued. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` to generate a fresh timestamp for each instance.
